algebraSwapCallback(int256,int256,bytes).details: In the implementation you must pay the pool tokens owed for the swap. The caller of this method _must_ be checked to be a AlgebraPool deployed by the canonical AlgebraFactory. amount0Delta and amount1Delta can both be 0 if no tokens were swapped.

params.amount0Delta: The amount of token0 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token0 to the pool.
params.amount1Delta: The amount of token1 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token1 to the pool.
params.data: Any data passed through by the caller via the IAlgebraPoolActions#swap call

params.amountInRequired: The desired amount of the first token to swap
params.path: The path of the swap, i.e. each token pair

returns.amountInList: The amount of the last token that should be paid
returns.amountOutList: The amount of the last token that would be received
returns.feeList: List of the fee values used for swaps in the path
returns.gasEstimate: The estimate of the gas that the swap consumes
returns.initializedTicksCrossedList: List of the initialized ticks that the swap crossed for each pool in the path
returns.sqrtPriceX96AfterList: List of the sqrt price after the swap for each pool in the path

params.params: The params for the quote, encoded as `QuoteExactInputSingleParams` tokenIn The token being swapped in tokenOut The token being swapped out amountIn The desired input amount limitSqrtPrice The price limit of the pool that cannot be exceeded by the swap

returns.amountIn: The amount of the `tokenIn` that should be paid
returns.amountOut: The amount of `tokenOut` that would be received
returns.fee: The fee value used for swap in the pool
returns.gasEstimate: The estimate of the gas that the swap consumes
returns.initializedTicksCrossed: The number of initialized ticks that the swap crossed
returns.sqrtPriceX96After: The sqrt price of the pool after the swap

params.amountOutRequired: The amount of the last token to receive
params.path: The path of the swap, i.e. each token pair. Path must be provided in reverse order

returns.amountInList: The amount of first token required to be paid

returns.feeList: List of the fee values used for swaps in the path
returns.gasEstimate: The estimate of the gas that the swap consumes
returns.initializedTicksCrossedList: List of the initialized ticks that the swap crossed for each pool in the path
returns.sqrtPriceX96AfterList: List of the sqrt price after the swap for each pool in the path

params.params: The params for the quote, encoded as `QuoteExactOutputSingleParams` tokenIn The token being swapped in tokenOut The token being swapped out amountOut The desired output amount limitSqrtPrice The price limit of the pool that cannot be exceeded by the swap
